title: A table variable is not filtered again by a CALCULATE that references it
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Colors = VALUES ( Product[Color] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Colors ), Product[Color] = "Red" ) )

source.quote: Variables are evaluated in the filter context where they are defined, and their evaluation happens at most once.
source.supports: a variable is evaluated where it is defined, not where it is used

source.quote: After DAX calculates the values for a variable expression, those values don't change, even if you reference the variable in another expression.
source.supports: the value of a variable does not change when it is referenced under another context

derivation: Colors is evaluated where it is defined, with no filter: Red, Blue, Green, 3 rows. The filter Color = Red applies to expressions evaluated inside CALCULATE, not to the rows the variable already holds, so COUNTROWS is 3. With VALUES ( Product[Color] ) in place of the variable it would be 1.
